title: Cinematic Hotel Advertisement
concept: A cinematic luxury hotel advertisement focused on atmosphere, architecture and premium visual storytelling.
image_prompt: Create a cinematic luxury hotel scene with sophisticated modern architecture, warm ambient lighting, premium interiors, realistic materials, natural shadows, elegant composition, cinematic depth of field, high-end commercial photography, ultra realistic details, 4K.
video_prompt: Create a cinematic luxury hotel advertisement with slow smooth camera movement, realistic environmental motion, premium lighting, natural depth and elegant commercial visual storytelling.

scene_guide.title: Opening
scene_guide.description: Establish the hotel location with a wide cinematic shot.

scene_guide.title: Reveal
scene_guide.description: Move toward the main subject using a smooth camera movement.

scene_guide.title: Details
scene_guide.description: Show premium architectural and interior details.

scene_guide.title: Final Shot
scene_guide.description: Finish with a strong cinematic reveal and branding.

title: Luxury Car Advertisement
concept: A premium automotive advertisement showcasing a luxury car through dramatic cinematic visuals.
image_prompt: Create an ultra realistic luxury car parked on a dramatic modern road at night, cinematic reflections, premium studio-quality lighting, wet asphalt, atmospheric environment, realistic materials, dramatic composition, shallow depth of field, automotive commercial photography, 4K.
video_prompt: Create a premium automotive commercial with slow cinematic camera movements around the vehicle, dramatic lighting changes, realistic reflections and smooth professional camera transitions.

scene_guide.title: Dark Opening
scene_guide.description: Begin with a dark cinematic environment and reveal the vehicle silhouette.

scene_guide.title: Front Reveal
scene_guide.description: Slowly reveal the headlights and front design.

scene_guide.title: Side Profile
scene_guide.description: Move smoothly along the side of the vehicle.

scene_guide.title: Hero Shot
scene_guide.description: Finish with a powerful wide shot of the complete vehicle.

title: Travel Destination Reel
concept: A cinematic travel reel designed to showcase a destination through beautiful landscapes and smooth camera movements.

video_prompt: Create a cinematic travel advertisement showing a beautiful tropical destination with smooth drone-style camera movement, natural environmental motion, realistic water movement and warm sunlight.

scene_guide.title: Aerial Opening
scene_guide.description: Start with a wide aerial view of the destination.

scene_guide.title: Landscape
scene_guide.description: Move toward the landscape and reveal environmental details.

scene_guide.title: Experience
scene_guide.description: Show the destination from a closer immersive perspective.

scene_guide.title: Final View

title: EV Scooter Advertisement

scene_guide.title: Product Introduction

scene_guide.title: Movement

title: Food Advertisement

scene_guide.title: Dark Opening
scene_guide.description: Reveal the dish gradually from a dark background.

scene_guide.title: Macro Detail
scene_guide.description: Show close-up details of the food texture.

scene_guide.title: Ingredient Shot
scene_guide.description: Highlight fresh ingredients and preparation details.

title: Tech Product Advertisement

scene_guide.title: Mystery Opening
scene_guide.description: Begin with a dark frame and reveal part of the product.

scene_guide.title: Product Reveal
scene_guide.description: Gradually reveal the complete product with controlled lighting.

scene_guide.title: Feature Detail
scene_guide.description: Focus on important design and technology details.

scene_guide.title: Final Hero
scene_guide.description: Finish with a clean premium product hero shot.
